articles.summary: No-show socks slipped down every time I walked and sometimes, even while I was sitting. Can you imagine the feeling when your socks are crumpled in your shoes and after every 5 mins you have to pull them back to their right position!! I thought that if people want to wear no-show socks but are unhappy with its current features, let us take the matters in our hands. We then set out to make the best possible no-show socks one could ever wear! That's how SockSoho no-show socks were born.💪 More
articles.title: How we created Revolutionary No-Show Socks? Hear from Pritika Mehta, founder of SockSoho
